package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestNormalizeStudentCourseAssignmentAllowsIndependentCourseIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	item, err := NormalizeStudentCourseAssignment(StudentCourseAssignment{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Status: CourseAssignmentAssigned,
		AssignedBy:               CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner,
		InitialPlanningRequestID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", AssignedAt: now,
	})
	if err != nil || item.CourseID != "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333" {
		t.Fatalf("normalize assignment: item=%#v err=%v", item, err)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeStudentCourseAssignmentRequiresArchiveTimestamp(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := NormalizeStudentCourseAssignment(StudentCourseAssignment{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Status: CourseAssignmentArchived,
		AssignedBy:               CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner,
		InitialPlanningRequestID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", AssignedAt: time.Now(),
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}
